description: Survivors of abuse by clergy members are defending a new Washington law against accusations from the U.S. Department of Justice that it is “anti-Catholic” and worthy of a federal investigation.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Noel Frame (D)
title: Abuse survivors defend WA law that feds slam as ‘anti-Catholic’ — Noel Frame: Democrat for State Senate - 36th LD
